The '''Galaxy Dagger''' is a [[Weapons#Dagger|dagger weapon]] that can be purchased at the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|35000}} after obtaining a [[Galaxy Sword]].

It can be combined with {{Name|Galaxy Soul|3|class=inline}} and {{Name|Cinder Shard|60|class=inline}} in the [[Forge]] to create an {{Name|Infinity Dagger|class=inline}}.
